# Typing speed & accuracy

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/typing-test/

Measure typing speed and character accuracy against a visible passage. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Type a short passage for 30 seconds and compare gross WPM with character accuracy.

## Limits and checks

Results depend on passage, keyboard and timing. This is a practice measurement, not a standardized hiring assessment.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
